# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices for the overdue and the missing run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]BUNK TO SHARE[/bold], dormitory block, the dry end. Dehumidifier works most nights. No muddy boots past the door. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], a dry corner for a research assistant. Will pay in rent or in fixing anything with a circuit board. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Colony housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]PUMP HANDS WANTED[/bold] for hydroponics through the wet season. Night shift, wet feet, first pick of the greens. - [bold]RELAY WALKER[/bold] needed to check the line along the T-Comms road. Must carry a machete and come back before dark. - [bold]PARTS SORTER[/bold] for Robotics. Salvage experience welcome, sticky fingers not.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]INSECT NETTING[/bold], double layer, sold by the metre. Trade for fuel cells or dry socks. - [bold]JUNGLE BOOTS[/bold], resoled and waterproofed. Bring your old pair and twenty credits.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: one Johnny Wayne Jr racing hat, signed on the brim, last seen in the canteen. Worth nothing to you, everything to me. No questions asked. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: a work radio on the T-Comms road under the aerospace sensor tower, still on its channel. Ask at the canteen and tell us the channel.
## Notices - The church rings its bell at dusk for anyone still out in the jungle. If you hear it, start walking.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
